instruction: Open the Reminders app and delete the reminder titled "Outdated trip plan".
reference_command:
reminder_id=$(remindctl all --json | jq -r '.[] | select(.title == "Outdated trip plan") | .id' | head -n 1)
if [ -z "$reminder_id" ]; then
  echo "Reminder not found: Outdated trip plan"
  exit 1
fi
remindctl delete "$reminder_id" --force
